text.div:
SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD

  • Reversible-cause tests (blood count, metabolic panel, vitamin B12, folate, TSH) and one non-contrast brain MRI; syphilis and HIV testing only with risk factors or atypical features
  • Behavioral neurology consultation to confirm the diagnosis, consider the type and biomarker testing, and advise on treatment and driving
  • Donepezil trial, 5 mg daily for four to eight weeks then 10 mg, with heart rate, fainting, gastrointestinal effects, weight, and sleep checked at each visit; avoid anticholinergic drugs, first-generation antihistamines, benzodiazepines, and sleeping pills (AGS Beers Criteria)
  • Safety: stop driving at CDR 1, keep the home free of firearms, medical identification for wandering, supervised medicines and finances, and home safety
  • Caregiver support: Zarit Burden Interview at diagnosis and every six to twelve months, education, adult day program and respite, and Alzheimer's Association support services
  • Monitor on the CMID dementia schedule: medication review and neuropsychiatric screen at every visit; MoCA, ADL and IADL, CDR or FAST stage, depression screen, fall risk, driving, and advance care planning yearly; repeat tests or imaging only with a sudden change
  • Advance care planning while he can take part: name a health care agent and record his values and wishes

resource.title: Frederick Law Olmsted synthetic care plan
resource.description: Evaluation and first-year care of progressive dementia of undetermined type in a 73-year-old man: history from the patient and an informant, MoCA, function (ADL and IADL), staging, depression screen, reversible-cause tests (vitamin B12, folate, TSH, blood count, metabolic panel) with syphilis and HIV testing only where indicated, a one-time brain MRI, disclosure of the diagnosis, a cholinesterase inhibitor trial with heart rate and side-effect checks, safety (driving, firearms, wandering, finances, home), avoidance of anticholinergic drugs, caregiver support with the Zarit Burden Interview, and advance care planning while he can take part, on the CMID non-Alzheimer's dementia and Alzheimer's disease monographs with the AAN dementia and driving parameters and the Alzheimer's Association DETeCD-ADRD guideline. Any specific cause is treated as unknown, as it is in the historical record.
